description: Agent Consent: submit the consent record behind a grant: its id, who gave the consent, how their identity is established (an account login, a verified ID, a signature, an email or phone confirmation, unverified or none), when they gave it, how it was captured (an explicit opt-in, a signed form, a recorded or unrecorded verbal agreement, a pre-ticked box, a default left on, a line in the terms, inferred, or other), what the principal was shown with the notice text, its version and when it was shown, where the record is kept, the system or person that captured it and the record’s own wording, read for wording that assumes consent such as by continuing you agree, implied consent or unless you opt out. The signed report gives the record with any wording that assumes consent, what was shown and whether it came before the consent, each part (who granted, when, how captured, what was shown, where kept) with its status, and counts the parts stated, and names evidence missing the principal’s agreement: no grantor, no time, no capture method, capture by a pre-ticked box, a default left on, a line in the terms or consent inferred from conduct, wording that assumes consent and a notice shown after the consent; then a notice not kept, no notice version, no time shown, an unrecorded verbal consent, an unverified grantor and no capturer, with the fix for each. A record with no notice, no identity method or no reference to its source is unverifiable. This reads the evidence that one principal agreed: whether a principal agreed to be remembered by a memory system is wever_memory-consent-check, privacy claims against a policy are wever_privacy-evidence-check, a delegation or mandate document’s terms are wever_delegation-check and how a negotiation mandate’s authorization is recorded is wever_negotiation-mandate-check. Verdict consent_evidence_missing, consent_evidence_partial, consent_evidence_unverifiable or consent_evidenced. POST /api/consent-evidence-check. Reads only the recorded consent material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write; no principal is contacted, no consent is requested, recorded, renewed or withdrawn and no data is used, moved or deleted. Agent Consent reads the grant the principal gave before the agent uses data or acts on it: whether the grant covers this use, whether it is still in force, whether it was withdrawn, whether the record proves it, what it was given for, whether the data may pass on and whether fresh consent is due. It is not the agent’s authority to act (wever_authority-scope-check reads an agent’s access list against the authority grant its operator gave it; a consent check reads the grant the principal gave over their own data: authority is not consent, and consent is not authority), not a mandate (the wever_mandate tools, wever_mandate-issue, wever_mandate-amend, wever_mandate-revoke and wever_mandate-draft, issue and change what an agent may trade or spend for a principal; a consent check reads what the principal agreed may be done with their data and changes nothing), not a data sample (wever_data-evidence-check reads a dataset sample’s fields and types; a consent check reads the permission behind using the data, not the data itself), not terms against a purchase (wever_terms-match-check reads purchases already made against their governing terms; a consent grant is the principal’s permission, not a seller’s terms), not a promise (the wever_commitment checks read what the agent promised; consent is what the principal granted, and an agent’s promise never stands in for it) and not an objective (the wever_goal checks read the objective the work serves; a consent check reads whether the principal’s grant allows the work at all). Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-consent-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-consent/.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

captured_by.description: The system or person that captured it.

identity.description: How the principal’s identity is established: an account login, a verified ID, a signature, an email or phone confirmation, unverified or none.

method.description: How it was captured: an explicit opt-in, a signed form, a recorded or unrecorded verbal agreement, a pre-ticked box, a default left on, a line in the terms, inferred, or other.

principal.description: Who gave the consent, as recorded.

reference.description: Where the record is kept, such as a form submission id or a recording.

notice.description: The notice the principal saw, as written.

text.description: The record as written, read for wording that assumes consent, such as by continuing you agree or implied consent.
